contexts.text: Those who belong to the gums.
His presence caused pain in the teeth and gums.
On the speech of the Spirits of Jupiter with me by means of the lips, and the gums of the teeth.
Hypocritical Genii operate into the right part of the teeth, gums, and jaw... and hypocritical Spirits into the left part. SE 4419. SE 4558. SE 5139. DMin 4648.
The sphere of (those who quarrel about religious things) causes a pain in the flesh of the teeth and gums.
